name: SMB AI Lead Capture & Appointment Reminder Pipeline
description: Auto-syncs web chatbot leads, qualifies via OpenAI GPT-4o, schedules in Google Calendar, and dispatches SMS/Telegram alerts
author: MinhLap AI Systems

modules.name: Inbound Lead Webhook
modules.description: Receives payload from Web Chatbot / Form

modules.name: AI Lead Qualification & Intent Parser
modules.description: Classifies urgency and extracts structured slot times

parameters.system_prompt: You are a professional medical & business receptionist. Extract the appointment intent, customer urgency, and format the requested timeslot.

modules.name: Schedule Calendar Hold
modules.description: Books tentative slot on Google Calendar with client details

modules.name: Instant Client SMS Confirmation
modules.description: Sends confirmation text with cancel/reschedule reply keyword

modules.name: Staff Telegram Alert
modules.description: Dispatches high-priority alert to clinic staff phone with 1-tap call button
